conditions: Should be called before initializing the IronSource SDK.
Parameters should be set according to the user's consent, privacy preference or user's age status.
effects: For GDPR: Sets user's consent status for data processing.
For U.S state privacy laws: Sets the restriction status for the sale or sharing of end-user's personal information.
For child-directed apps: Sets a flag indicating if the end-user is a child as per the applicable regulations.

For apps involved in the Google Play's Designed for Families Program: Sets device id opt-out flag, child-direction flag, and Google family self-certified SDKs flag as per policy requirements when directed at children or mixed-audience.

conditions: This setting should be used when the user has opted out of the 'sale' or 'sharing' of personal information as per U.S state privacy laws.
effects: Restricts the sale or sharing of end-user's personal information.

conditions: This setting should be used when the user has permitted the 'sale' of personal information as per U.S state privacy laws.
effects: Allows the sale or sharing of end-user's personal information.

conditions: This setting should be used when the end-user is a child as per applicable regulations for child-directed apps, or for directed/ mixed-audience apps in Google Play's Designed for Families program.
effects: Flags the specific end-users as children which may modify the advertising behavior to comply with COPPA or other applicable laws.

conditions: This setting should be used when the end-user is not a child as per applicable regulations for child-directed apps.
effects: Flags the specific end-users as non-children.

conditions: This setting should be used for apps primarily directed at children and should be set before initializing the SDK, or for directed/ mixed-audience apps in Google Play's Designed for Families program.
effects: Prevents access to the Android Advertising ID (AAID) which may enhance user's privacy but potentially impacting the app's monetization performance.

conditions: This setting should be used for apps directed at a mixed audience in Google Play's Designed for Families program and should be set before initializing the SDK.
effects: Allows initialization of only the Families Self-Certified Ads SDKs for users flagged as children or of unknown age in mixed-audience apps.
